user_prompt: We need to verify that all the materials we're sourcing from our new suppliers meet current environmental and safety regulations, and simultaneously pull their complete specifications and vendor details so our procurement team can process these orders efficiently.

steps.step_name: Verify that all materials from new suppliers meet current environmental and safety regulations

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt/shipment recording), Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine (sales opp→order)
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY (OpportunityQualificationAdvisor, SalesProductChangeCoordinator, VendorMaterialProcurementCoordinator, SalesCompensationOrchestrator, CampaignAudienceOptimization agents) - NO receivables/billing APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health agents - SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator, IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer (analyzes incidents/trends), IncidentResponseCoordinator, ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (REST API for real-time PO status tracking + vendor monitoring), agents for invoice reconciliation & supplier compliance
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (NO create API)
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator, SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator, HazmatIncidentComplianceMonitor
- siemens.plm: PLM - EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning, BOMComplianceValidator (validates BOM against regulatory standards, restricted substance directives, supplier qualifications), SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator (supplier qualification + material validation + vendor compliance monitoring), QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY APIS:
- sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 - REST API exposing PurchaseOrder & Vendor entities; enables monitoring POs (financial commitments) + vendor master (payment terms)
- sap.ariba:apiResource:SourceingCampaignAndAccountManagementAPI:v1 - REST API for campaigns/accounts

SUPPLIER QUALIFICATION & MATERIAL COMPLIANCE:
siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1 - Automates vendor assessment, material qualification workflows, monitors vendor compliance status, validates materials against engineering specs & regulations, processes supplier performance metrics

INVOICE RECONCILIATION (VENDOR/AP SIDE):
sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 - Three-way matching, validates line-items, flags exceptions (overbilling, duplicates, policy), routes to payment

ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE / CUSTOMER INVOICING / COLLECTIONS:
**NO RESOURCE IN LANDSCAPE** - No A/R, billing, or customer invoice system found. S/4 and CRM have sales-related agents but no receivables APIs. Landscape has strong A/P (Ariba) but no corresponding AR counterpart.
